Ready-to-live-in housing for every employee, in Paris and the surrounding region

We select and book the housing that fits the assignment: its length, its location, the number of people and your budget.

Three formats, depending on length and rhythm of the assignment

Furnished apartment

For stays of a month or more. A real home with a kitchen, a place to work and peace and quiet. The format for consultants, relocated executives and expatriates.

Aparthotel

For stays of a few weeks. The comfort of an apartment with hotel services: cleaning, reception, linen.

Hotel

For short stays and last-minute arrivals. We book with establishments we know, near the place of work.

What we check before proposing a property

A property is not a listing. We choose it as if it were for a member of our own team.

Location
Real travel time to the workplace, by public transport or car, at the hours your employee will actually commute.
Quiet and comfort
Bedding, insulation, light, space to work. The difference between a stay endured and a stay enjoyed.
Equipment
Full kitchen, washing machine, reliable wifi, TV. Everything needed to live, not just to sleep.
Terms
Duration, flexibility, cleaning included or not, deposit: everything in writing before booking.

For groups and teams

Several people on the same project or site? We house teams in the same building or neighbourhood, with equivalent commutes to the site. Single rooms, shared apartments or hotel: we propose what fits the budget and complies with your sector's accommodation rules.

The earlier you tell us, the more choice we have. But we also know how to handle an unplanned arrival.

Housing questions

Who signs: the company or the employee?

In most cases the booking is made in your company's name; the company remains our contractual contact and receives the invoices. Your employee pays nothing up front and signs nothing on site except the check-in inventory.

What if the assignment runs longer?

Tell us, and we extend the stay or arrange a follow-on solution with no disruption for the employee.

Can you house a family?

Yes. For an expatriation or a relocation we look for housing that suits the family: number of bedrooms, neighbourhood, proximity to schools.

Sending people to Paris? Call us.

In ten minutes we will understand your needs and tell you what we can do. In English or French, no commitment.
